I added two deny rules to `.claude/settings.json`, using the same `./` path style as your existing `Read(./secrets/**)` rule:

```json
"Read(./infra/prod/**)",
"Edit(./infra/prod/**)"
```

- **`Read`** blocks Claude's file-reading tools (Read, Grep, Glob) from anything under `infra/prod/`.
- **`Edit`** covers every file-writing tool (Edit, Write, NotebookEdit), so Claude can't create, change or overwrite files there.
- Deny rules win over allow and ask rules. Because this is the checked-in project settings file, the block applies to everyone using the repo, including subagents like `infra-dev` and `sre`.

**Remaining gap:** these rules only cover Claude's own file tools. A shell command like `cat infra/prod/main.tf` or `sed -i ...` could still get to those files. To close that, you could turn on sandboxing (which enforces file access for shell commands too) or add a PreToolUse hook on `Bash` that rejects any command mentioning `infra/prod`. I can set up either one if you want.

Your project instructions say to run `make lint` and `make test` before finishing, but I don't have a shell tool in this session, so I haven't run them. This change only touches Claude's settings file, so it shouldn't affect either one, but you may still want to run them.
